rules.text: Ang bao is not an expense

claims.why: That's a duck. Chairs don't quack.
A bowling ball is not lunch. Even for Sales.
Toner doesn't sparkle, Kelvin.
That's a game controller. Ghost is gaming, not charging.
Beer is not hydration. Rejected, cheers.
Kelvin's 'tasting' was the whole bottle.
Even the CFO can't expense whisky. One eye, one rule.
Shandy has beer. 'Mostly lemonade' is still beer.
$68 of mala. The client was Bat.
$38 chicken rice? That's not a portion, that's a mortgage.
Over $20. Blame Kelvin's biscuit habit.
Founder or not, food caps at $20.
Dated Saturday. No weekend claims, even for HR.
Sunday stapling? Nobody staples on Sunday, Kelvin.
Saturday golf is a hobby, not a meeting.
Sunday. Even the CFO's batteries rest on weekends.
6:45 PM is too early. Also, mum isn't a client.
5:31 PM isn't late. That's one minute after 5:30.
8:55 AM Grab. Oversleeping isn't after 10 PM.
9:59 PM. One minute early. Rules are rules.
You can't claim tomorrow's lunch today.
Next Monday hasn't happened yet. Even for wizards.
Dated tomorrow. Celebrate after it happens.
Next Friday. Keen, but time travel isn't claimable.
Shopee order. Even a great deal is a no.
Free shipping, Kelvin. Not free money.
Bought on Shopee. And Ghost's camera is always off.
Shopee again. Motivation not approved.
4:45 PM kopi. Nothing after 3 PM, CFO.
3:30 PM kopi. Also, $18 for ONE kopi?
3:01 PM. One minute over. Kopi denied.
5 PM kopi. Client meeting or not, no.
Team bonding, 1 pax. Kelvin bonded with himself.
Karaoke alone isn't team bonding. It's a cry for help.
1 pax massage. That's self-care, Auntie, not bonding.
$12. Interns cap at $10. Spirit noted.
Interns max $10. Your wrist can wait.
Grab time's fine, but interns max $10. Kelvin wasn't impressed.
$25 of name cards. You have no clients, Jun Wei.
On MC means no claims. Also, why a webcam?
MC day Sentosa trip. Get well soon. Rejected.
On MC with a client? Pick one, Bat.
Generous! But ang bao isn't an expense, boss.
Kelvin gave himself an ang bao. Nice try.
Weddings are lovely. Still not an expense.
$19.60, before 3 PM. Fourteen kopi, zero rules broken.
After 10 PM, and Grab has no cap. Server says thanks.
$19.90 is under $20. Sad, but valid.
2 pax counts. Barely a team, but a team.
$9.99. One cent under. Jun Wei did the maths.
Robe matches, weekday, not food. Wizardry has no cap.
Eye drops are fine. CFO only needs half.
Under $20. Milo is morale.
Not food, weekday, no Shopee. Auntie stays warm.
2:59 PM is before 3. Ghost lives to haunt again.
Rude, but valid. Kelvin's one honest claim.
10:01 PM counts. Bat finally followed a rule.
Under $20, weekday. Kindness approved.
$5.60 is under $10. It's not team bonding, just sad.
Parking coupons, weekday, cheap. Approved.
No cap on courses. Let the CFO have Excel.
Not Grab, not kopi. 3 AM is just Ghost's lunch.
$6 of ice. Auntie keeps the office alive.
Umbrella matches, weekday, no rule broken. Bat stays dry.
Flags, weekday, no Shopee. Majulah, approved.
2:30 PM, $1.40. Jun Wei followed every rule.
12 pax is a real team. Approve the boss.
11:45 PM Grab is allowed. The audit was not fun.
Cable matches, weekday, cheap. IT approved.
$3 tissue, no Shopee. Chope culture is essential.

rule_intro.pic: Per my last email: the picture must match the item.
rule_intro.booze: No alcohol. I've seen the Friday claims. All of them.
rule_intro.food: Food and drinks capped at $20. Bat, this is personal.
rule_intro.weekend: Weekends don't exist. Not for claims. Not for you.
rule_intro.grab: Grab only after 10 PM. Before that, the MRT builds character.
rule_intro.future: No future dates. Only I can see the future.
rule_intro.shopee: Shopee orders are not business. Noted with thanks.
rule_intro.kopi: No kopi after 3 PM. You'll sleep. I won't.
rule_intro.bonding: Team bonding needs a team. Two people minimum. I checked.
rule_intro.intern: Interns max $10. Jun Wei knows what he did.
rule_intro.mc: On MC? Then rest. Properly. No claims.
rule_intro.angbao: Ang bao is a gift, not an expense. Huat yourself.

caught: Interesting. I'll be resubmitting that. In a different font.
Rejected? I'll circle back. With a bigger circle.
Fine. Noted with thanks. I've noted you, specifically.
That was a test. You passed. Unfortunately.
I'm cc-ing your manager. Oh wait. That's me.
Wow. Okay. Per my last email: wow.
I'll remember this at your appraisal. Vividly.
Fine. I'll pay for it myself. Like a peasant.
Rejected. Adding you to my special spreadsheet.
You just declined a SENIOR accountant. Bold.
fooled: Approved! Lovely. I'll invoice you the processing fee.
Thank you. Your signature's on it now. Not mine.
Wonderful. That's coming out of your bonus. Kidding. Not kidding.
Processed. Pleasure doing business with someone who doesn't read.
Approved by you. Remember that at the audit.
Thanks. Invoice KLV-0001 attached. For your trouble.
Excellent. I'll take the MRT to celebrate. Kidding. Grab.
See? Teamwork. I claim, you pay.
I'll add a small admin fee. Small for me.
Approved. Officially, I now owe you nothing.
correct: Correct. Don't let it go to your head.
Even a jammed printer prints sometimes.
wrong: Wrong. Per my last email, which you didn't read.
The rules are ON the screen. Literally right there.
Incorrect. Screenshotting this for the group chat.
Walao. Wrong one. Adding it to your file.
Wrong. I've printed it out. In colour.
Wrong. The printer jams less than you.
Incorrect. Let's discuss. Meeting tomorrow, 8 AM.
Wrong stamp. Finance is a privilege, not a vibe.
morning: You caught me {caught} times yesterday. I've updated my spreadsheet. On you.
{wrong} wrong stamps yesterday. I framed them.
Day {streak}. I'm getting pettier, not tired.
Good morning. I've reviewed your {wrong} mistakes. Twice.
You caught me {caught} times. My lawyer is my cousin.
{streak} days in a row? Don't you have a life? Same.
Caught me {caught} times yesterday. Today I'm wearing a disguise.
Zero hard feelings about yesterday. Zero. I counted.
New rule today. I wrote it at 3 AM. Angrily.
{streak}-day streak. HR says I'm not allowed to 'reset' you.
Morning. Your kopi was on my desk. Was.
Receipts are on your desk. Alphabetised by grudge.
report: End of day. Report filed. You'll hear from me. Indirectly.
That's all. Please don't screenshot this. Please do, actually.
Day closed. I'll be reviewing your reviews.
Thanks for your time. I've invoiced it.
Report done. My spreadsheet is very full tonight.
Go home. Grab only after 10 PM, remember.
Good work. That was physically hard to type.
Noted with thanks. Same time tomorrow. I'll be ready.
fired: Budget's gone. So are you. Please return the stapler.
Morale hit zero. I'm finally happy. You're fired.
Your access card stops working in five minutes. Bye.
Fired. I'm claiming your farewell cake. 1 pax.
overtime: Unpaid overtime. My favourite kind of time.
Still here? Overtime isn't claimable. I checked. For you.
Keep stamping. Aircon goes off at 7 though.
Endless claims. Endless me. Welcome to finance.

gloop: Rejected? Scheduling a feelings check-in. With myself.
HR will remember this. In a good way. Maybe.
*sad blob noises* That was valid, you know.
cfo: I've had my one eye on you.
That was valid. I literally run finance.
bat: But it was a client meeting! Sort of.
The client will hear about this. Somehow.
Rejected? I'm escalating this. To the ceiling.
ghost: I'll raise a ticket. Priority: emotional.
Valid claim. You've lagged. Try restarting yourself.
auntie: Aiyo, valid one leh! No Milo for you.
I run the pantry. Remember that, ah.
Wah, rejected? Your mug is going missing.
intern: Did I do it wrong? Wait. No. You did.
I'll write a reflection essay about this!
It's okay! I'll cry in the pantry. Quietly!
boss: I founded this company. With magic. Approve it.
My robe is disappointed in you.
Rejected the founder? Bold. I respect it. No, I don't.
